question: Should bare `/model status` and `/model list` be reserved Control UI subcommands even when configured model IDs collide, and which branch should carry the canonical fix?
rationale: The bug is real, but the submitted fix changes model-selection semantics and the existing linked issue already tracks the canonical work, so maintainers need to choose the command contract before this branch can be repaired or closed.

options.title: Require a disambiguated current-main fix
options.body: Refresh or replace the PR so `list` and `status` follow the documented Control UI flows while preserving an explicit path for selecting real model IDs.

options.title: Reserve keywords intentionally
options.body: Accept that bare `status` and `list` are no longer selectable model IDs, but document the collision behavior and prove the auth/provider status path works.

options.title: Close this PR and keep the issue canonical
options.body: Use the open issue as the tracker and ask for a fresh, narrow PR with proof instead of carrying this stale branch forward.

recommendation.title: Require a disambiguated current-main fix
recommendation.body: Refresh or replace the PR so `list` and `status` follow the documented Control UI flows while preserving an explicit path for selecting real model IDs.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has recent focused history on Control UI model-command handling and is a strong owner for the command-contract decision.
